title: Conditionals: grade letter
prompt:
Write gradeLetter(int $score): string that converts a 0–100 score to a letter:

  90–100 → "A"    80–89 → "B"    70–79 → "C"    60–69 → "D"    0–59 → "F"

If the score is below 0 or above 100, return "Invalid".

    // TODO: if / elseif / else (or match) chain

hints: Check the invalid range first (score < 0 || score > 100) and return early.
An if / elseif chain from the highest grade down works: if ($score >= 90) ... elseif ($score >= 80) ...
solution:
<?php
function gradeLetter(int $score): string
{
    if ($score < 0 || $score > 100) {
        return 'Invalid';
    }

    return match (true) {
        $score >= 90 => 'A',
        $score >= 80 => 'B',
        $score >= 70 => 'C',
        $score >= 60 => 'D',
        default      => 'F',
    };
}
